## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Boundary impact

- [ ] The upstream Trezor submodule remains unmodified, or its reviewed gitlink update is explained.
- [ ] Privileged supervisor behavior is unchanged or documented in the supervisor project.
- [ ] USB-visible behavior is unchanged or documented.
- [ ] Display, button, storage, entropy, or lifecycle changes are documented.
- [ ] No wallet seeds, passphrases, keys, state files, or other secrets are included.

## Validation

List repository checks, builds, host-software tests, Raspberry Pi tests, and
hardware or oscilloscope validation performed.
